content: Cefprozil is administered orally. For patients with impaired renal function, cefprozil can be administered without contraindication. A specific dosage schedule should be followed for these patients. For patients with impaired hepatic function, no dosage adjustment is required. When preparing the oral suspension, it should be reconstituted at the time of dispensing. To facilitate preparation, add water in two separate portions and shake the mixture well after each addition. Once mixed, the suspension should be stored in a refrigerator and any unused portion must be discarded after 14 days. The dry powder should be stored at a temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F) prior to reconstitution.
